summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 285 Chinese source units, all nine temporal or active-hint items, and all three people. This chapter is an astronomical annals record prefaced by a philosophical discussion of heaven and human affairs. Its Confucius references are undated literary allusions and its phrase 聖人既沒 supplies an undated death statement, not the external BC 551–479 lifespan presently attached to three attestations and the active hint. Those four derived records are source-specific research holds. The Yao and Shun qualitative legendary-antiquity records remain supported without invented Western chronology. No source or canonical extraction was changed.

That imported life interval and its active-date hint need an independently pinned biographical source; the chapter itself does not supply it.
